query: What distinct aspects of food quality do reviewers focus on?

per_column.name: facet_taste
per_column.rationale: Taste/flavor is a core sensory aspect OF food quality; a genuine constitutive facet.

per_column.name: facet_texture
per_column.rationale: Texture/mouthfeel is an intrinsic sensory dimension of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_freshness
per_column.rationale: Freshness is a constitutive attribute of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_smell_aroma
per_column.rationale: Aroma is a distinct sensory aspect of food quality, non-overlapping with taste in principle.

per_column.name: facet_appearance
per_column.rationale: Visual appearance is a recognized quality dimension of food.

per_column.name: facet_ingredients_nutrition
per_column.rationale: Ingredient/nutritional composition is an intrinsic aspect of food quality.

per_column.name: facet_packaging_quantity
per_column.rationale: Packaging and quantity are attributes of the product/delivery, not constitutive aspects OF the food's quality itself; also conflates two unrelated notions (packaging vs. amount).

per_column.name: facet_consistency_brand
per_column.rationale: Brand is an external identifier/reputation predictor, not a facet of food quality; bundling 'consistency' with 'brand' further muddies the aspect.

per_column.name: primary_quality_facet
per_column.rationale: This is a roll-up/argmax over the other facet columns, restating the whole rather than adding a distinct constitutive aspect; it also overlaps entirely with the individual facet flags.

judge.rationale: Most columns are genuine constitutive facets of food quality (taste, texture, freshness, aroma, appearance, ingredients/nutrition), covering the main sensory and compositional aspects fairly well. However exclusivity is weakened by conceptual overlaps (taste vs. smell_aroma vs. freshness co-vary; 'consistency' overlaps with texture) and by bundled columns ('packaging_quantity', 'consistency_brand') mixing two ideas each. packaging_quantity and consistency_brand fail the meronymy test: packaging/quantity/brand are external product attributes or reputation predictors, not aspects OF the food's intrinsic quality. primary_quality_facet is a restatement/aggregate of the whole rather than a distinct part. These non-facet inclusions and overlaps lower the MECE quality despite good coverage of the true facets.
